subject: Starlake pilot — private deployment access, HSM custody and commercial concession
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Green <aisha.green@starlaketx.com>, Procurement <procurement@starlaketx.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Starlake pilot - private deployment ask + draft SOW

Hi Aisha / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, Starlake would like to run a 3-month pilot on a private deployment (VPC) with the following non-standard asks: 

- HSM-backed key custody option where Starlake holds the key in a partner HSM (read-only access for Redwood runtime).
- Timebound audit window: allow Starlake auditors access for a 48-hour on-site log review during the pilot (agreement on scope).
- Strict egress restriction: no cross-region backups for pilot data, egress limited to your specified CIDR.
- Commercial request: 30% usage discount for the pilot in exchange for a 12-month commit if successful.

Attached: Starlake_Security_Addendum_v1.pdf (security asks) and Starlake_SOW_v1.docx (pilot SOW).

Next steps from our side: Jordan and I will work the commercials and surface what needs exec sign-off. Can we get your target dates for the pilot start and auditors availability?

Thanks,

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

From: Procurement <procurement@starlaketx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Aisha Green <aisha.green@starlaketx.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Starlake pilot - private deployment ask + draft SOW

Marissa,

Thanks for the SOW. Aisha forwarded and asked me to follow up on a couple of details we need to commit to procurement: 

1) KMS/HSM: We need proof that Redwood can integrate a customer-held HSM (we prefer vendor X HSM) such that Starlake retains custody of the private key and Redwood operates with a wrapping key.
2) Audit access: We require a 48-hour window with read-only access to logs and the ability to run a short integrity check. That window must be guaranteed in contract language.
3) Discount: We can agree to the 12-month commit, but procurement needs an upfront pilot concession (we requested 30%).

Please confirm whether Redwood can accept the HSM custody model and if this is an exec-level concession for the pilot. If so, please route to your legal/dealdesk and confirm turnaround for a redline.

Regards,
Procurement (on behalf of Starlake)
procurement@starlaketx.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Starlake pilot - commercial + HSM custody ask (deal desk review)

Elliot / Laura — escalating for exec clearance. Highlights below (pros/cons and ask).

Summary of asks from Starlake:
- Customer-held HSM key custody for the pilot (vendor X preferred).
- Contractual 48-hour read-only audit window during pilot.
- 30% pilot concession with 12-month commit if pilot successful.

Commercial impact:
- 30% off for the pilot is outside standard pilot discounts; revenue impact ~-$45k over the pilot (estimate).
- HSM custody introduces potential ops risk and complexity (offline key custody flows + runbook changes).

Proposed exec decision options (please pick):
A) Approve pilot carveout: Accept HSM custody (with defined operational controls), sign the redlined addendum; approve 30% pilot concession.
B) Conditional approval: Offer 20% pilot concession; require Starlake to use our managed KMS and provide a signed escrow arrangement for HSM integration later.
C) Deny HSM custody but provide a technical integration plan and 15% pilot concession.

Request: Laura / Elliot — need sign-off today or tomorrow to keep pilot slot in January. If approved, I will circulate the redline (legal) and get the DocuSign route ready.

-Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 10:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Starlake pilot - commercial + HSM custody ask (deal desk review)

Jordan / team — quick read and conditional approval from Exec/legal.

Key points we will accept for pilot (conditions below):
- HSM custody: APPROVED for the pilot only if Starlake supplies the HSM vendor details and executes an integration runbook. Redwood will operate with a wrapped key provided by Starlake; Redwood retains no escrow of the primary private key.
- Audit window: APPROVE a single 48-hour read-only audit window during the pilot. Audit scope must be limited to logs and runtime metadata; no access to underlying customer data stores. Audit time must be scheduled 2 weeks in advance.
- Egress/CIDR: ACCEPT as long as it does not conflict with infra HA requirements; infra to confirm technical feasibility.
- Discount: Approve 25% pilot concession (counter to their 30%) in exchange for a signed 12-month minimum committed usage at our published enterprise rates. Any deeper concession requires VP approval.

Actions:
- Laura: circulating a redlined Starlake_Security_Addendum_redline_v2.pdf (attached). Legal to add the exact audit-scope language and timebox the HSM integration as a pilot-only amendment.
- Jordan: prepare the commercial terms (25% pilot concession) and update the HubSpot deal.
- Elliot/Infra: please confirm HSM ops runbook and whether the vendor is supported within our private deployment options. We need infra confirmation by EOD 12/4.

If infra/ops confirm by EOD, I will approve signature authority to execute the pilot agreement. Anything outside the above requires VP sign-off.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
VP, Legal & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.inference.com>
To: Aisha Green <aisha.green@starlaketx.com>, Ben Howard <ben.howard@starlaketx.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Dec 2025 16:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Starlake pilot - private deployment access, HSM custody and commercial concession

Aisha / Ben — following up with executive sign-off summary and next steps.

Thanks for laying out your security requirements; we've reviewed internally and can proceed under the following agreed pilot terms: 

- HSM custody: Redwood will accept a customer-held HSM for the pilot (vendor X supported). Starlake will provide the HSM and runbook; Redwood will operate against a wrapped key. Redwood will not escrow the primary private key.
- Audit window: One scheduled 48-hour read-only audit window during the pilot. Scope limited to runtime logs and system metadata; no raw data store access. Audit must be scheduled at least 14 days in advance.
- Egress/CIDR: Redwood will honor the specified CIDR restriction for pilot snapshots, provided infra confirms no HA conflicts.
- Commercial: Exec approval granted for a 25% pilot concession. This is contingent on a signed 12-month committed usage agreement executed within 30 days of pilot completion.

Attachments: Starlake_Security_Addendum_redline_v2.pdf (redline). Next steps: 
1) Marissa to circulate the final redline and DocuSign link.
2) Starlake to confirm HSM vendor/serial and provide signed runbook.
3) Jordan to update HubSpot (DL-2025-4109) and schedule the contract route.

DocuSign (preview): https://www.docusign.com/en-us/sign/SLK-4109-Exec-Consent

Elliot
Elliot Price
